name: DIP Corporation
summary: DIP Corporation engages in the human resources service business in Japan and the United States. The company offers dip AI, a dialogue-based part-time job search service; Baitoru talk, a communication app for store managers and part-time employees; Baitoru, a portal website for part time employees; Spot Baitoru, a job matching service that connects people who want to work in their spare time with establishments looking for workers; Baitoru NEXT, a job information website for those who are looking to work as regular or contract employees; Baitoru PRO, a job information site for specialized jobs; Hatarako net, a portal website connecting companies with those seeking regular, dispatched or part-…
